tagline: Leading pure-play provider of behavioral healthcare services in the United States, operating acute inpatient psychiatric facilities, specialty treatment facilities, comprehensive treatment centers, residential treatment centers, and outpatient behavioral healthcare services across 40 states and Puerto Rico.
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of facilities is a key indicator of Acadia's geographic reach and operational capacity, reflecting its position as the undisputed leader in behavioral healthcare services in the United States.

kpis.name: Number of Facilities
kpis.explanation: Total number of behavioral healthcare facilities owned and operated by the company.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, Acadia operated 277 behavioral healthcare facilities.

kpis.name: Number of Beds
kpis.explanation: Total bed capacity across the company's behavioral healthcare facilities.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, Acadia's facilities had over 12,500 beds.

kpis.name: Beds Added
kpis.explanation: Number of beds added during the fiscal year through expansions or new facilities.
kpis.description: During the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, 1,089 beds were added.

kpis.name: Comprehensive Treatment Centers Opened
kpis.explanation: Number of new Comprehensive Treatment Centers (CTCs) opened during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: During the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, 15 CTCs were opened.

kpis.name: Revolving Credit Facility Amount
kpis.explanation: Total amount available under the revolving credit facility.
kpis.description: The company has a $1.0 billion revolving credit facility.

kpis.name: Term Loan Amount
kpis.explanation: Total amount of the senior secured term loan.
kpis.description: The senior secured term loan facility amounts to $650.0 million.

kpis.name: Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of consolidated total net debt to consolidated EBITDA, maximum covenant threshold.
kpis.description: The company must maintain a consolidated total net leverage ratio of 5.0x or lower under its credit covenants.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of financial health and covenant compliance.

kpis.name: Share Repurchase Authorized
kpis.explanation: Amount authorized for repurchase of common stock under the share repurchase program.
kpis.description: A share repurchase program authorizing up to $300.0 million was approved on February 25, 2025.

kpis.name: Beds Added through Joint Ventures
kpis.explanation: Number of beds added via joint venture partnerships.
kpis.description: During the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, 778 beds were added through the opening of five joint venture facilities with Henry Ford Health, Geisinger Health, Ascension Seton, Fairview Health Services, and ECU Health.

kpis.name: Beds Added through Existing Expansions
kpis.explanation: Number of beds added through expansion of existing facilities.
kpis.description: During the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, 311 beds were added to existing facilities.

risks.title: Variable-rate debt sensitive to interest rates
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the Market Risk section, with clear language on the impact of a 1% increase in interest rates reducing pre-tax income by $10.4 million. The amount of variable-rate debt is significant. Capital category heavily weighted.

risks.title: High risk of litigation and professional liability
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, with a negative adjustment of $52.7 million in 2025. The reserve amount ($181.8 million) more than doubled versus 2024. Alarming language on increased claim frequency and less favorable insurance conditions.

risks.title: High revenue concentration on Medicaid
risks.score_rationale: Medicaid represents 57.7% of revenues (2025), with explicit mention of regulatory complexity and potential retroactive adjustments. The risk is recurring and amplified by growing dependence.

risks.title: Recurring impairments on fixed assets
risks.score_rationale: Presence of non-cash impairments on fixed assets ($10.4 million in 2025) related to site closures. The amount is moderate but repeated, indicating ongoing restructuring.

risks.title: Complexity of revenue accounting estimates
risks.score_rationale: Detailed section on revenue estimates, with risk of material variances due to rate adjustments. Explicit mention of potentially material impact on financial results.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence was found in the text.
